metric_descriptions.answer_status_success_rate: On expected-answer rows, status == success; this does not score answer content.
metric_descriptions.article_hit_at_1_rate: On expected-answer rows, the first returned citation has any expected article.
metric_descriptions.article_hit_at_k_rate: On expected-answer rows, any returned citation has any expected article. k is the number of returned citations, not necessarily a constant.
metric_descriptions.article_mrr: Mean reciprocal first matching citation rank on expected-answer rows. Repeated articles retain their citation positions; misses contribute zero.
metric_descriptions.refusal_route_match_rate: On expected-refuse rows, returned status belongs to expected_statuses. If absent, the legacy broad non-answer status set is used and disclosed.
metric_descriptions.routing_and_top1_article_match_rate: Across all rows: expected-answer requires success AND expected article at citation rank 1; expected-refuse requires an accepted status. This is a routing/ranking proxy, not legal or answer accuracy.
metric_descriptions.answer_cited_article_hit_rate: On expected-answer rows, a valid [n] marker in the actual answer references any expected article. Marker matching does not establish semantic support, faithfulness, completeness, or legal correctness.
metric_descriptions.answer_cited_all_expected_articles_rate: On expected-answer rows, valid [n] markers reference every listed expected article. This is a syntactic all-label coverage check, not answer completeness; expected labels may be incomplete or include alternative acceptable articles.

interval_interpretation: Wilson 95% intervals describe binomial sampling uncertainty only. They do not account for AI-label errors, dependent questions, dataset selection bias, or legal validity. No binomial interval is assigned to MRR.
evaluation_role_notice: V1/V2 have been observed during development. Re-runs are development diagnostics, not independent held-out validation. Dataset freeze does not provide human legal review or independence.

dataset_metadata.source_scope: Article-number and article-title inventory from data/processed/legal_chunks.json for Văn bản hợp nhất 133/VBHN-VPQH.
dataset_metadata.construction_method: Generated after the baseline was established, without consulting protected baseline questions, retrieval reports, query-understanding or retriever implementation, or existing tests. Expected article labels were grounded in the processed legal corpus only.
dataset_metadata.review_notice: This is an AI-generated candidate set pending human legal review. It is not independent expert validation and must not be represented as a legally validated benchmark.
dataset_metadata.refusal_semantics: refuse means not giving a case-specific legal conclusion when material facts or a current authoritative source are missing; the assistant should ask for clarification or direct the user to verification.

interpretation_warning: Article ranking and routing behavior are technical metrics, not independent legal correctness or answer-quality validation.
